hypothesis: createReservationItems_ validates each batch entry against the same un-decremented available_quantity (ensureInventoryLevels lines 173-192), then sums the adjustments per (item, location). A single cart with two lines sharing the WIDGET inventory item, whose combined demand exceeds the 10 seeded units, should be completed and produce an order whose units exceed stock. I expect no_oversell to fail (order lines need more WIDGET units than were stocked), and reserved_matches_reservations to hold since the counter is summed consistently.
